service_name.description: Name of the executable binary for the accessibility settings daemon (typically gsd-a11y-settings)

desktop_entry_name.description: Human-readable name of the desktop entry

only_show_in.description: Semicolon-separated list of desktop environments where this autostart entry is visible

no_display.description: If true, hide this entry from menus/desktops

autostart_phase.description: Phase of autostart execution (e.g., Initialization, Applications)

autostart_notify.description: If true, send a notification when autostart completes

auto_restart.description: If true, automatically restart the daemon if it crashes

hidden_under_systemd.description: If true, hide the service under systemd management
